articles.title: Anthropic's post-debut stumble delivers reality check for AI trade
articles.description: Anthropics shares fell about 9% after their market debut, deepening concerns over stretched AI valuations and showing that even a marquee listing has not revived investor enthusiasm for the sector. The focus is now shifting to whether Anthropic can justify its roughly 40-times-sales valuation and whether a potential OpenAI IPO next year can restore appetite for AI stocks.

articles.title: Fake AI websites mimic ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude in malware threat
articles.description: Cybersecurity firm Island has uncovered 186 fake websites impersonating 27 major artificial intelligence (AI) brands including ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, DeepSeek and Perplexity. The attackers use a typosquatting technique dubbed "TypoPrompting" to snare users who mistype web addresses, diverting them to malicious sites that trick victims into installing malware or leaking sensitive search data to third parties.
